$comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Config for tools/inventory/dealer-inventory-priority.js and dealer-vehicle-image.js — pulls LIVE new-vehicle inventory counts per model from a dealer site and emits a stock-depth-ranked run-list for a Meta ad set. Copy this file and edit dealer/models/slots to match your own dealer site and monthly offer build.
label: Example Motors — monthly Meta offer set

dealer.name: Example Motors
dealer.$comment_platform: Adjust to your own dealer site's inventory-search rendering. This example assumes a d2cmedia-style SRP where each rendered result carries a hidden <input name=vehicledata data-make/model/year/trim/stock-number/vin/condition/km>; adapt the scraping logic in dealer-inventory-priority.js if your platform differs.

ad_model.$comment: How many ad sets each creative unit is duplicated into (e.g. multiple targeting audiences sharing the same creative). ads = creative_units * ad_sets.

thresholds.$comment: count <= hold_at_or_below => HOLD (don't advertise what we don't have). count <= thin_at_or_below (and > hold) => THIN/limited (run 1 design). Otherwise RUN full, ranked by count desc.

slots.note: evergreen brand slot, no model gate
